device.description: 12-bit 200-500 kSPS SAR ADC with SPI-compatible serial output
device.note: adc121s051.pdf (SNAS302I) p.1 connection diagram, p.2 pin descriptions, p.3 operating ratings, p.5 output coding, p.6 timing specifications, p.7 serial timing diagram, p.13-14 serial interface

pages: p.1-2 (pins: VA1 GND2 VIN3 SCLK4 SDATA5 CS6), p.3 (operating ratings: VA 2.7-5.25 V, digital inputs -0.3 to 5.25 V regardless of VA), p.5 (straight binary), p.6 (tEN 20 ns, tACC 40 ns at 2.7-3.6 V, tDIS 25 ns), p.7 (3 leading zeros + 12 data bits), p.13-14 (frame, TRI-STATE after the 16th falling edge)
notModeled: analog input; the conversion is clocked by SCLK (the result is the 0 V code 0x000 at once)
SPI mode 3 (data out on SCLK falling edges, read on rising edges); with SCLK low at CS fall the receiver may capture an extra (fourth) leading zero (datasheet), which mode 3 does not show
SDATA goes TRI-STATE after the 16th falling SCLK edge (idle "z" after the 15 pattern bits) or at CS rise
shutdown mode: CS high between the 2nd and 10th SCLK falling edges powers down until the next CS fall (no visible digital effect; the 1 us power-up time is not modeled)
CS high between the 10th and 16th falling edges aborts the conversion
tQUIET / tACQ and SCLK frequency limits; digital inputs up to 5.25 V regardless of VA (equal to the vcc max, so no inputMax); tACC is 20 ns at VA 4.75-5.25 V (the model uses 40 ns)
variants: ADC121S021 / ADC121S051 / ADC121S101 are the same pinout and frame at 50-200 / 200-500 / 500-1000 kSPS (separate datasheets); ADC081S/ADC101S are the 8/10-bit parts; the WSON (NGF) package in the datasheets has no orderable part in the skeleton
